title: Jude and 2 Peter
aka: synoptic problem of the Catholic Epistles
lead: Most of Jude 4–18 reappears, mostly in the same order, in 2 Peter 2:1–3:3. One letter used the other, or both used a common source. Along with Ephesians and Colossians, it is one of the two closest literary relationships between New Testament letters.
